# FLX-3104: referenced contract does not satisfy the pinned fluidVersion

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The emit pins the FLUID version it was written against, exactly or as a semver range. The referenced document declares a version outside that pin, so the schema the emit was checked under is not the schema the contract is written in.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3104
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
